item.title: RSS Test 1 - Language and Understanding
item.description:
Language and Understanding

This is an original test passage for KOReader. If you can read this paragraph in an EPUB, the reader has successfully retrieved and converted the content embedded in the RSS feed without requesting the linked page.

A central question in the philosophy of artificial intelligence concerns the relationship between linguistic competence and understanding. A system may produce a coherent response to a novel question. Further inquiry concerns the capacities that support this response and the role that the response plays in a shared linguistic practice.

Reading question

What kinds of evidence would distinguish a stable linguistic capacity from a response that succeeds only in a particular context?

END OF TEST ARTICLE.
